title: Personalizing travel at scale with OpenAI
summary: By integrating its data systems with OpenAI’s LLMs, Booking.com delivers smarter search, faster support, and intent-driven travel experiences.
body: By integrating its data systems with OpenAI’s LLMs, Booking.com delivers smarter search, faster support, and intent-driven travel experiences.
summaryZh: 知名旅游平台Booking.com通过将自身数据系统与OpenAI的大语言模型相集成，实现了规模化的旅游个性化定制服务。该应用提供了更智能的搜索、更快速的支持以及基于用户意图的旅游体验，展示了大模型在垂直电商领域的深度落地应用。

aiReview.reasonZh: Booking.com集成OpenAI大模型以实现旅游搜索和客户支持的规模化个性化，是真实世界大模型落地的典型案例。
